newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares close mixed, BUX ends slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares close mixed, BUX ends slightly up.

text.p: 1140 GMT - Hungarian shares closed mixed on Monday, with the BUX index remaining steady with a slight positive tone.
* The BUX index finished at 7,401.46 points, up 5.21 points or 0.07 percent.
* Sixteen stocks ended higher, fifteen and the compensation coupon lower and seven shares remained flat.
* The volume of traded stocks and coupons totalled 1,288,689.
* Heavy-weight stocks were also mixed, with chemicals TVK closing up by 90 forints at 3,910, OTP Bank losing 45 to close at 6,455 and oil company MOL ending down by 15 at 4,275 forints.
